title: Clay Classes (ongoing)
source_quote: your work will be finished in a high-fire gas reduction or raku kiln
evidence_sentence: The clay studio page states that clay students' work finishes in a raku kiln.
evidence_quote: your work will be finished in a high-fire gas reduction or raku kiln
summary: The Craft Guild offers ongoing clay classes for potters of all levels that include raku firing. Multiple class types are available (Introduction to Ceramics, wheel-throwing, handbuilding, glazing), and tuition covers kiln firing costs.
how_to_join: Enroll in a clay class through the Guild's registration system.
